name: Structure Tools
description: Auto-builds level structure in the editor. Stage 1: fill pillars under platforms.

fill-block-id.name: Fill Block ID
fill-block-id.description: Object ID used to fill pillars. <cy>0</c> = use the same block as the platform (solid blocks only). Slopes always need an ID here. Easiest way to set it: select ONE block in the editor and press <cg>Pick ID</c>.

ground-y.name: Ground Row Y
ground-y.description: Y position of the lowest block row sitting on the ground. In the normal editor this is <cy>105</c>. Pillars stop here.

max-rows.name: Max Pillar Height
max-rows.description: Safety limit: the most blocks one pillar can have (in rows).
